hook: Listen to Anna and Ben talk about moving into a new flat.

translation.vi: Mình vừa thuê một căn hộ.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: You've already found a place? Great!

translation.vi: Bạn đã tìm được chỗ rồi à? Tuyệt!

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: The rent is good. The house has a big room.

translation.vi: Tiền thuê cũng ổn. Căn nhà có phòng rộng.

gloss.en: money you pay every month to live in a flat or house.
a set of rooms on one floor.
a part of a house with walls.

grammar_notes: We use the present perfect with 'just' for something that happened a very short time ago. We use 'already' to say something happened before now, often sooner than expected.
interaction_prompts: Have you ever just moved to a new home? What did you like about it?
